<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const mod = (n, m) => ((n % m) + m) % m;

  function svgEl(name, attrs, parent) {
    const node = document.createElementNS(NS, name);
    for (const key in attrs) node.setAttribute(key, attrs[key]);
    if (parent) parent.appendChild(node);
    return node;
  }

  // Small stones and dry strokes move beneath the alpaca, creating camera-follow motion.
  const trackItems = [];
  const trackLayer = $("trackLayer");

  for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
    const item = svgEl("g", { opacity: 0.22 + (i % 4) * 0.055 }, trackLayer);
    if (i % 3 === 0) {
      svgEl("ellipse", {
        cx: 0, cy: 0,
        rx: 3 + (i % 5),
        ry: 1.6 + (i % 2),
        fill: "#8e795e",
        transform: `rotate(${(i * 23) % 35 - 17})`
      }, item);
    } else {
      svgEl("path", {
        d: `M${-5 - (i % 4)} 0 Q0 ${-1 - (i % 2)} ${6 + (i % 5)} 0`,
        fill: "none",
        stroke: i % 2 ? "#9b8666" : "#f0e0bf",
        "stroke-width": 1.5 + (i % 2),
        "stroke-linecap": "round"
      }, item);
    }
    trackItems.push({
      node: item,
      x: (i * 97 + 41) % 1440,
      y: 548 + (i * 47) % 102
    });
  }

  const legs = [];

  function makeLeg(parent, cfg) {
    const group = svgEl("g", {
      opacity: cfg.far ? 0.84 : 1
    }, parent);

    const hip = svgEl("circle", {
      r: cfg.far ? 12 : 14,
      fill: cfg.upper
    }, group);

    const upperEdge = svgEl("path", {
      fill: "none",
      stroke: cfg.edge,
      "stroke-width": cfg.far ? 21 : 24,
      "stroke-linecap": "round",
      "stroke-linejoin": "round",
      opacity: 0.7
    }, group);

    const upper = svgEl("path", {
      fill: "none",
      stroke: cfg.upper,
      "stroke-width": cfg.far ? 17 : 20,
      "stroke-linecap": "round",
      "stroke-linejoin": "round"
    }, group);

    const upperLight = svgEl("path", {
      fill: "none",
      stroke: cfg.light,
      "stroke-width": cfg.far ? 3 : 4,
      "stroke-linecap": "round",
      opacity: cfg.far ? 0.22 : 0.4
    }, group);

    const lowerEdge = svgEl("path", {
      fill: "none",
      stroke: cfg.edge,
      "stroke-width": cfg.far ? 14 : 16,
      "stroke-linecap": "round",
      "stroke-linejoin": "round",
      opacity: 0.72
    }, group);

    const lower = svgEl("path", {
      fill: "none",
      stroke: cfg.lower,
      "stroke-width": cfg.far ? 10 : 12,
      "stroke-linecap": "round",
      "stroke-linejoin": "round"
    }, group);

    const knee = svgEl("circle", {
      r: cfg.far ? 5.5 : 6.5,
      fill: cfg.lower
    }, group);

    const hoof = svgEl("g", {}, group);
    svgEl("path", {
      d: "M-6-6 C-2-9 6-8 9-4 L11 2 C8 6-5 7-9 3Z",
      fill: cfg.hoof
    }, hoof);
    svgEl("path", {
      d: "M4-5 L5 4",
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "#443b34",
      "stroke-width": 1.2,
      "stroke-linecap": "round",
      opacity: 0.55
    }, hoof);
    svgEl("path", {
      d: "M-5-5 Q1-7 6-5",
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "#c4ad8c",
      "stroke-width": 1.2,
      "stroke-linecap": "round",
      opacity: 0.45
    }, hoof);

    legs.push(Object.assign({}, cfg, {
      hip, upperEdge, upper, upperLight, lowerEdge, lower, knee, hoof
    }));
  }

  const farPalette = {
    edge: "#9d7e5c",
    upper: "#c5a47b",
    lower: "#b28e66",
    light: "#ead1aa",
    hoof: "#75624f",
    far: true
  };

  const nearPalette = {
    edge: "#b29168",
    upper: "#e1c49a",
    lower: "#d1af83",
    light: "#fff0cf",
    hoof: "#69584a",
    far: false
  };

  // Touchdowns occur in a calm lateral four-beat sequence:
  // near hind, near front, far hind, far front.
  makeLeg($("farLegs"), Object.assign({}, farPalette, {
    x: 98, y: 325, ground: 478, stride: 54,
    offset: 0.5, bend: 1, lift: 27
  }));
  makeLeg($("farLegs"), Object.assign({}, farPalette, {
    x: 278, y: 325, ground: 478, stride: 54,
    offset: 0.25, bend: -1, lift: 30
  }));
  makeLeg($("nearLegs"), Object.assign({}, nearPalette, {
    x: 132, y: 330, ground: 482, stride: 58,
    offset: 0, bend: 1, lift: 30
  }));
  makeLeg($("nearLegs"), Object.assign({}, nearPalette, {
    x: 307, y: 330, ground: 482, stride: 58,
    offset: 0.75, bend: -1, lift: 33
  }));

  const bodyMotion = $("bodyMotion");
  const headGroup = $("headGroup");
  const tail = $("tail");
  const tassel = $("tassel");
  const earNear = $("earNear");
  const eye = $("eye");
  const shadow = $("alpacaShadow");
  const cloudA = $("cloudA");
  const cloudB = $("cloudB");

  const cycleDuration = 2.3;
  const stanceFraction = 0.64;
  const groundSpeed = 58 / (cycleDuration * stanceFraction);

  function updateLeg(leg, cycle, bob, rock) {
    const p = mod(cycle + leg.offset, 1);
    let footOffset;
    let footLift = 0;
    let hoofPitch = 0;

    if (p < stanceFraction) {
      // Planted hoof travels backward at a constant speed.
      footOffset = leg.stride * (0.5 - p / stanceFraction);
    } else {
      // Swing: the hoof rises, reaches forward, and settles softly.
      const q = (p - stanceFraction) / (1 - stanceFraction);
      const eased = q * q * (3 - 2 * q);
      footOffset = -leg.stride * 0.5 + leg.stride * eased;
      footLift = leg.lift * Math.sin(Math.PI * q);
      hoofPitch = -10 * Math.sin(Math.PI * q) + 3 * Math.sin(TAU * q);
    }

    const angle = rock * Math.PI / 180;
    const c = Math.cos(angle);
    const s = Math.sin(angle);

    // Match the hip to the gently rocking torso.
    const hx = 190 + (leg.x - 190) * c - (leg.y - 265) * s;
    const hy = 265 + (leg.x - 190) * s + (leg.y - 265) * c + bob;

    const fx = leg.x + footOffset;
    const fy = leg.ground - footLift;

    let dx = fx - hx;
    let dy = fy - hy;
    let distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    distance = Math.max(distance, 0.001);

    const upperLength = 78;
    const lowerLength = 88;
    const ikDistance = Math.min(distance, upperLength + lowerLength - 0.5);
    const ux = dx / distance;
    const uy = dy / distance;

    const along = (
      upperLength * upperLength -
      lowerLength * lowerLength +
      ikDistance * ikDistance
    ) / (2 * ikDistance);

    const height = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,
      upperLength * upperLength - along * along
    ));

    const baseX = hx + ux * along;
    const baseY = hy + uy * along;
    const kneeX = baseX + (-uy) * height * leg.bend;
    const kneeY = baseY + ux * height * leg.bend;

    const upperPath = `M${hx.toFixed(2)} ${hy.toFixed(2)} L${kneeX.toFixed(2)} ${kneeY.toFixed(2)}`;
    const lowerPath = `M${kneeX.toFixed(2)} ${kneeY.toFixed(2)} L${fx.toFixed(2)} ${fy.toFixed(2)}`;

    leg.upperEdge.setAttribute("d", upperPath);
    leg.upper.setAttribute("d", upperPath);
    leg.upperLight.setAttribute("d", upperPath);
    leg.lowerEdge.setAttribute("d", lowerPath);
    leg.lower.setAttribute("d", lowerPath);

    leg.hip.setAttribute("cx", hx);
    leg.hip.setAttribute("cy", hy);
    leg.knee.setAttribute("cx", kneeX);
    leg.knee.setAttribute("cy", kneeY);
    leg.hoof.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `translate(${fx.toFixed(2)} ${fy.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${hoofPitch.toFixed(2)})`
    );
  }

  let startTime;

  function animate(now) {
    if (startTime === undefined) startTime = now;
    const t = (now - startTime) / 1000;
    const cycle = (t / cycleDuration) % 1;

    // Two gentle vertical oscillations per full stride, plus a subtle lateral rock.
    const bob = 2 * Math.cos(TAU * 2 * cycle + 0.5);
    const rock = 0.8 * Math.sin(TAU * cycle);

    bodyMotion.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `translate(0 ${bob.toFixed(2)}) rotate(${rock.toFixed(2)} 190 265)`
    );

    const headNod = -rock * 0.55 + 0.85 * Math.sin(TAU * cycle - 0.7);
    headGroup.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `rotate(${headNod.toFixed(2)} 330 105)`
    );

    tail.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `rotate(${(4 * Math.sin(TAU * cycle - 0.8)).toFixed(2)} 64 229)`
    );

    tassel.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `rotate(${(7 * Math.sin(TAU * cycle + 0.4)).toFixed(2)} 351 163)`
    );

    earNear.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `rotate(${(1.8 * Math.sin(t * 1.7) + 0.7 * Math.sin(t * 3.1)).toFixed(2)} 353 54)`
    );

    for (const leg of legs) updateLeg(leg, cycle, bob, rock);

    shadow.setAttribute("rx", (150 + bob * 1.5).toFixed(2));
    shadow.setAttribute("opacity", (0.215 + bob * 0.007).toFixed(3));

    // A brief natural blink every few seconds.
    const blinkTime = t % 6.4;
    let blink = 0;
    if (blinkTime > 6.05) {
      blink = Math.sin(Math.PI * (blinkTime - 6.05) / 0.35);
    }
    eye.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `translate(366 72) scale(1 ${Math.max(0.12, 1 - 0.9 * blink).toFixed(3)})`
    );

    for (const item of trackItems) {
      const x = mod(item.x - t * groundSpeed + 80, 1440) - 80;
      item.node.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${x.toFixed(2)} ${item.y})`);
    }

    const cloudAX = mod(150 + t * 4 + 220, 1720) - 220;
    const cloudBX = mod(820 - t * 2.2 + 220, 1720) - 220;
    cloudA.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `translate(${cloudAX.toFixed(2)} ${(104 + 2 * Math.sin(t * 0.08)).toFixed(2)})`
    );
    cloudB.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `translate(${cloudBX.toFixed(2)} 196) scale(.78)`
    );

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
})();
</script>
